# parseDiffJson

## Summary

Parses a refine or targeted-edit change-set reply: critique/score/featureCheck plus the `changed`, `removedNodeIds`, `materialsChanged`, and `added` arrays. It strips markdown fences, slices out the JSON object, retries once with trailing commas removed, and throws when no JSON is present. Unlike `parseSpecJson`, all four change arrays may legitimately be empty, so each is simply defaulted to `[]` rather than rejected.

## Import

```ts
import { parseDiffJson } from '../util/spec-io';
```

## Usage

Passed as the `parser` to `requestSpec` by the studio's refine and targeted-edit calls (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) and by `RefineSculptCommand` (`commands/refine-sculpt-command.gts`). The parsed diff then goes to `applySpecDiff` in `../util/spec-diff` to be merged into the current spec.
